newsitem.title: UK: Hanson to buy U.S. firm Concrete Pipe.
newsitem.headline: Hanson to buy U.S. firm Concrete Pipe.

text.p: Britain's Hanson Plc said on Thursday a U.S. unit agreed to buy Concrete Pipe and Products Co for about 78 million stg, including debt.
Hanson said the deal would consolidate its Cornerstone Construction & Materials Inc unit's position as one of the largest concrete pipe producers in the U.S.
Concrete Pipe, headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, had an operating profit of about 10 million stg in 1996 on sales of 66 million stg.
Completion of the deal was expected in April, Hanson said in a statement. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
